page.overview:
Who is Pickle Girard?

Dilbert "Pickle" Girard is a major character in The Breaking Wheel, the second story of Fazbear Frights #7: The Cliffs. He is a teenage science nerd and one of Reed's few friends.

Pickle is short and dark, like his twin sister Shelly. He has unusually deep-set eyes, a nearly black unibrow, a strangely small mouth filled with crooked teeth, and a big, long beaky nose. Despite his eating habits, Pickle is rather skinny.

Pickle is a science nerd who can come off as thoughtless sometimes because he gets wrapped up in his books and projects. He’s also rather matter-of-fact with his behavior and intelligence, which adds to his unintentionally mean demeanor. Pickle is too uninterested in others’ shortcomings to make fun of them like Julius, and he can usually come off as disinterested. He also loves eating and mathematics. Pickle lacks coordination, making him a bit clumsy at times. He also can’t read interpersonal visual cues, struggling to decipher facial expressions, body language, and other social cues. To make up for it, Pickle remembers everything he reads and hears.

Reed had been friends with Shelly and Pickle for nearly ten years around the time the story takes place. In their freshman year, Shelly and Pickle convince Reed to join a robotics class. In the first week of class, Pickle begins to believe that the teacher is an android, and begins planning on proving his hypothesis, however Shelly doesn't let him go forward with any plans.
